bibliographic.title: The Blink
bibliographic.author: Briggs
bibliographic.description:
WARNING: This story contains swearing, descriptions of death/suicide, and a little smidge of existential dread.

A short text game with multiple endings where you explore the story of Sergeant, a member of the IORATA; a research/survey vessel and a last-ditch effort to overcome an equally inevitable and unexplainable extinction event.

Estimated length: 2k-4k words per run depending on your choices. The additional text document contains optional lore if anyone's interested. Please let me know if there are any issues, I'd like to keep working on this and make it feel a lot more fleshed out. Any and all feedback is welcome.
